### 15. tasks-extension-compatibility-decision

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Route | deepen (execution re-vet) |
| Diagnosis | The repository pins `ModelContextProtocol` 2.2.0 but does not reference or configure the separately published Tasks extension. ADR 0003 defers the surface through a retired umbrella-row pointer and records none of the opt-in, retention, logging, or process-lifetime compatibility constraints needed by the execution children. |
